detailZones.title: Automated cabinet control face
detailZones.description: Trace the visible touchscreen, scanner recess, access panels, cable channel, trim and cabinet base.

detailZones.title: Matrix drawers and pockets
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible matrix pockets, drawer faces, rails, dividers, handles, latches and cabinet liner.

detailZones.title: Medication refrigerator
detailZones.description: Study the visible refrigerator door, glass, gasket, shelves, clips, LED strip, vent and generic packages.

detailZones.title: Pharmacy preparation counter
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible pharmacy worktop, trays, cups, vials, racks, printer, scanner and lower storage.

detailZones.title: Medication storage and supplies
detailZones.description: Compare the visible wall shelves, generic cartons, bottles, trays, bins, rack dividers and storage hardware.

detailZones.title: Cabinet bases and wall services
detailZones.description: Trace the visible cabinet bases, ventilation openings, floor finish, wall rail, outlets and service panels.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 automated-dispensing-cabinet photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 147 independently pointable cabinet, touchscreen, drawer, medication-pocket, refrigerator, counter, supply and base-service parts. Patient identity, medication identity, access authorization, inventory level, dispensing result, temperature, safety status, readable labels and hidden software were excluded.
